title: mac-slot reads the load under the caller's locale: with a decimal-comma locale every reading is unreadable, so the first read fails open and the load cap never applies
evidence: tools/mac-slot.sh load() runs `sysctl -n vm.loadavg` without LC_ALL=C; under de_DE.UTF-8 it prints "{ 6,44 37,19 64,92 }" (measured in review of PR 1424). Brad's Mac is en_NZ and agent shells run with LANG empty, so no effect today. Fix: LC_ALL=C on the sysctl call
